text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uuu... It's over for meee. Someone like me 
doesn't deserve to run in races...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, your reputation is going to drop 
too because you became my trainer, isn't 
it...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... uuu... I'm so sorry... forgive 
mee...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
You can just abandon a hopeless girl like 
me already, really...!
choice_data_list: Let's keep giving it our all together!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Is it really okay for someone like 
me to stay by your side, Trainer-san...?
choice_data_list: Let's not rush and just keep at it.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fuehh... Thank you so much for being so 
kind to someone like meee...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Without rushing... right. Don't rush, 
don't rush... Phew.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
All right... I-I'll try my best, one step 
at a time. Please watch over me, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeees...! When it comes to never giving 
up, I won't lose...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I want to win... Trainer... I want to win 
so badly...!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I won't whine anymooore! Please keep being 
tough on me from now on, I-I'm beggin' 
youuu!!
